text:
Aisha (CS): Hey team — Rosetta is asking to split the upcoming invoice across two legal entities (Rosetta US + Rosetta EU). They want different approvers and payment methods. Can we confirm flow?
Ben (Finance): Do we have PO numbers for both entities yet? If not, payment terms default to Net30.
Aisha (CS): No PO yet. Customer asked if we can do Net60 on the EU chunk while keeping Net30 on the US chunk. They also asked whether the EU portion can be wired and US on card.
Dan (Account Exec): Confirmed on call earlier — customer will try to get a PO for EU by EOD. They want the card charged same day for US if we can split amounts.
Clara (Legal): Two quick things: 1) Are we changing the contract term or just splitting billing entity? 2) If EU is invoiced separately, we need correct legal entity name and VAT details for the invoice.
Aisha (CS): It’s a billing split only — no term change. Rosetta EU legal name: Rosetta GmbH, VAT DE123456789. Rosetta US: Rosetta, Inc., EIN 12-3456789.
Ben (Finance): OK. If EU provides a PO that references Rosetta GmbH we'll set Net60 on that invoice. Can Ops/Onboard verify the invoices will be sent to two different billing emails?
Ops-Onboard: Please send the two billing emails. Also, if card is used for the US portion, we need auth to charge partial amount — do you want us to capture a token and invoice remainder?
Dan (Account Exec): I'll get billing emails now: billing-us@rosetta.com and billing-eu@rosetta.eu. For card, customer approved a one-time card charge for US portion. Ben — can you create two invoices scoped to the appropriate amounts/lines?
Ben (Finance): Will do. I'll draft two invoices and attach PO fields once we have POs. Sending the EU draft as Net60.
Aisha (CS): For signatures: they asked for one Docusign with two signers (one for each entity) to acknowledge the split amendment. Is that okay/legal?
Clara (Legal): We can use a single amendment that lists both entities and has separate signature blocks. Add a recital clarifying no term change and the effective date of the split. I can draft language — ping me the invoice numbers once Ben creates them.
Dan (Account Exec): Great — I'll coordinate signers and confirm who signs for Rosetta GmbH (legal contact is Lena Meyer).
Aisha (CS): Lena Meyer (lena@rosetta.eu) is the EU signer. US signer is Jason Park (jason@rosetta.com).
Clara (Legal): Drafted amendment and comments added. Aisha — please confirm signers and emails, then I'll push to Docusign.
Aisha (CS): Confirmed. Pushing to docusign when Ben posts invoice numbers.
docusign-bot: Envelope created: env_0a9f3c — "Rosetta Billing Split Amendment". Sent to Lena Meyer (lena@rosetta.eu) and Jason Park (jason@rosetta.com).
Aisha (CS): Heads up — Lena just requested a redline: wants payment schedule line calling out VAT handling for EU invoice. Clara — can you review quickly?
Clara (Legal): On it. Will add VAT clause and resend to docusign.
docusign-bot: Envelope updated: env_0a9f3c (redline applied). Waiting for signatures.
Ben (Finance): Invoices created: INV-2026-045A (US, card, Net30) amount $45,000; INV-2026-045B (EU, wire, Net60) amount €38,000. Attached to amendment.
Aisha (CS): Thanks Ben. Sent numbers to Clara.
Dan (Account Exec): Rosetta confirmed they will submit EU PO today. If PO arrives, Ben — will you update invoice with PO reference?
Ben (Finance): Yes — will add PO ref once received.
Aisha (CS): Quick ask from Enablement — once signed, can we schedule a 30-min handoff with the onboarding team to verify feature access mapping across entities? Rosetta wants separate seat allocations per entity.
Ops-Onboard: That works. Please add preferred time windows.
Dan (Account Exec): They prefer next Tue 10–12 CEST.
Aisha (CS): Noted. Final check — any blockers on routing payments? Bank wiring details for EU invoice included in invoice notes; card capture scheduled once US signer signs.
Clara (Legal): No blockers from legal.
docusign-bot: Envelope completed: env_0a9f3c — Signed by Lena Meyer and Jason Park. Timestamp 1793214654.
Aisha (CS): Signed — thanks all. Ben — proceed with charging card for US portion and mark EU invoice awaiting PO/wire.
Ben (Finance): Charging US card now. Will update ledger and notify when settled.
Aisha (CS): Awesome — I'll set the onboarding handoff and close the loop when payment confirmed. :party_parrot:
